heading: ### The tick and the pin read

findings.quote: the three labels are not exhaustive — when the recorded revision is not an ancestor of the branch tip and the live file equals the tip blob, all three read no
findings.why: Those two conditions are not sufficient for 'all three read no': the `current` row reads `current` whenever the tip blob's sha equals the recorded pin (which holds when the file is byte-identical at a non-ancestor recorded revision and at the tip — fixture A), and the `drift` row reads `drift` whenever `git status --porcelain -- <path>` is non-empty (which holds with the live file equal to the tip blob whenever HEAD is detached at a working-copy parent holding other bytes — fixture B), so a reader applying the note literally mislabels cases the table above it decides; the note needs the missing 'the recorded pin differs from the tip blob and the worktree is clean' qualifiers.
